description: This Java source file defines the SearchActor class, an Akka actor responsible for handling various thing search commands (CountThings, QueryThings, StreamThings, etc.) within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages query parsing, delegates persistence operations, and streams search results, acting as a core component in the thing search functionality.

classes.name: SearchActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for processing search-related commands for things, including executing queries, counting, streaming results, and handling namespace reports within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for the SearchActor with specified query parser and persistence dependencies.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines how the actor handles incoming messages of specific types.

methods.name: namespaceReport
methods.description: Handles SudoRetrieveNamespaceReport commands, generating and piping the namespace count report.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Processes CountThings commands, executing a count query.

methods.name: sudoCount
methods.description: Processes SudoCountThings commands, executing a sudo count query.

methods.name: executeCount
methods.description: Performs the counting operation, managing query parsing, execution, and response piping.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Handles StreamThings commands, executing streaming search results.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles QueryThings commands, executing standard search queries.

methods.name: stopTimerAndHandleError
methods.description: Stops the timer and manages error recovery in the flow.

methods.name: processSearchPersistenceResult
methods.description: Logs and forwards search persistence results.

methods.name: asDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts Throwable into DittoRuntimeException, logging errors.

methods.name: toQueryThingsResponse
methods.description: Constructs response objects for query commands based on search results.

methods.name: startNewTimer
methods.description: Initializes a new performance timer for metrics collection.

methods.name: createQuerySource
methods.description: Creates a source stream from a query parser, handling exceptions.

methods.name: stopTimer
methods.description: Stops a given timer, handling potential IllegalStateException.
